'''Decipher Cards Only (Modified)''' is a constructed format: every Decipher-printed card, with five cards banned. It is GEMP's [[Decipher Cards Only]] pool ([[Premiere - Theed Palace]]) with a ban list, and the [[Retro League]] used it in 2025.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp" /><ref name="t85241" />

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee GEMP
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card, with a ban list
* '''In use:''' 2025
* '''Also called:''' Decipher Cards Only (modified)<ref name="t85241" />
* '''[[GEMP]]:''' ''Decipher Cards Only (Modified)'' (<code>open_no_virtual_m</code>) on both the Players Committee GEMP and play.swccg.com

== Card pool ==
Its pool is every Decipher-printed card, set ids 1&ndash;14 and premium ids 101&ndash;112, like GEMP's [[Decipher Cards Only]] (<code>open_no_virtual</code>). Unlike [[Classic (no v-cards)]], it has no icon bans.<ref name="pc-gemp" /> The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

=== Ban list ===
GEMP bans five cards:<ref name="pc-gemp" /><ref name="cardjson" />
* Dark Side: ''An Entire Legion Of My Best Troops'', ''Boonta Eve Podrace'', ''Coruscant: Galactic Senate''
* Light Side: ''Boonta Eve Podrace'', ''Coruscant: Galactic Senate''

== History ==
For the 2025 season, [[Classic (no v-cards)]] and Decipher Cards Only (Modified) replaced Premiere - Endor and Premiere - Reflections II in the [[Retro League]].<ref name="t85234" /> It was the format of [[2025 Retro League Event 5]], 28 September &ndash; 9 November 2025, which [[Joe Horbey]] won.<ref name="t85241" /> It is not in the [[2026 Retro League]], whose four events end with [[Classic (no v-cards) (Modified)]].<ref name="t86346" />
